notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
This update makes further adjustments to card burning to achieve the following:

[list]
[*] Bring gold production back in balance with hammers
[*] Increase player options on a turn if they're willing to sacrifice cards
[*] Don't require players to burn a card every turn for optimal play
[*] Maintain the slower overall progression and rewards for planning from the last patch
[/list]

Rule Changes
[list]
[*] Card burns now always yield 1 hammer (except Firewood)
[*] Firewood cards are initially called "Timber" and turn into Firewood next turn
[*] Timber burns like any other card, Firewood burns for 2 hammers and 1 science
[*] Starting deck includes 1 Firewood and 1 Timber
[*] Lumbermills built on same hex multiple times by same player will not give additional Timber
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] Civ selection changes so you can view info for your currently selected civ
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where using Mass Produce and then Lumbermill would result in Lumbermill card being drawn instead of Firewood/Timber
[*] Fixed an issue where city growth text from Capital placement could appear off screen
[*] Fixed an issue where hex detail popups would appear when score screen is in foreground
[/list]

Misc
[list]
[*] Various performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: August Update - Balance and New Rules
notes.content:
Most of the [b]Experimental Rules[/b] are now implemented in the default game. These changes encourage players to grow their economies through improvements, buildings, and wonders, rather than relying on burning cards. The old game rules are playable with the [b]Legacy Mode[/b] custom game options.

[h3]Rule Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Card burns now give 5 gold for first burn per turn then 4,3,2,1
[*] Firewood burns still give 2 hammers and 1 science
[*] Palace gives 1 more hammer
[*] Mine adds 1 additional hammer to yield
[*] Fishing Hut now also adds 1 gold to yield
[*] Huts are more likely to give science
[*] Hut spawn rates increased
[*] Removed Embark hammer cost
[*] Scout gather hammer cost removed
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Imperial Guard now starts with General promotion instead of Vanguard
[*] Imperial Guard cost reduced to 9 hammers
[*] General Promotion now buffs nearby units immediately when applied and at start of each turn
[*] Mamluk gold cost increased to 6
[*] Removed shuffle gold cost reduction from China
[/list]

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:

Several were not powerful enough to justify the cost of reaching them in the tech tree or to not almost always burn them in favor of playing other cards. [*] [b]Mass Produce[/b] - Now always drawn at start of your turn if it is in your deck
[*] [b]Annex[/b] - Also claims all unclaimed hexes adjacent to target hex. Cost increased to 10 gold
[*] [b]Courthouse[/b] - Now also produces 4 gold. Culture production increased to 4
[*] [b]Garrison Promotion[/b] - Now produces 2 happiness in a city and reduces maintenance cost by more. Defense bonus increased slightly
[*] [b]Craftsmanship [/b]- Now also gives 1 gold per building or improvement. Roads no longer count. Range reduced to 2.
[*] [b]Pathfinder Promotion[/b] - Now also removes terrain movement penalty for unit itself
[/list]

notes.title: The Hexarchy Boats and Vikings Update is Now Live—with a 33% Discount too!
notes.content:
Hello Hexarchists!

It’s the update you’ve all been waiting for—the boats and Vikings are here! In this update you can enjoy a new unit, a new ability, and even a whole new civilization. PLUS Hexarchy’s going to be on sale with its biggest ever discount of 33% from May 23rd so now’s the time to grab your friends and don your finest horned helmet!

[h3][b]New Naval Unit[/b][/h3]
Watch your back because you and your enemies can now attack from the water with the [b]Warship[/b]! This ranged unit has 7 strength so beware if you’re building your cities on the coast!

[h3][b]New Unit Ability[/b][/h3]
It’s not just the warships that can set sail, use [b]Embark[/b] to turn any unit into a boat that can travel on water! Sneak up on your enemies overseas and discover new lands to conquer.

[h3][b]The Vikings[/b][/h3]
A new civilization is here and their perks pack a punch. The Vikings bring with them the [b]Ulfhednar[/b]—an 8 strength unit that can embark for free from any hex AND the Ulfhednar card gains 1 strength every two turns. The Viking’s ability is [b]FRENZY[/b], this allows you to give a unit 8 strength, charge, and mobilize for one turn all at once! Triple threat!

[h3][b]New worlds[/b][/h3]
Bring your new units and civilisation to new map types; Pangea, Continents, and New World. [b]Pangea[/b] is the classic all one continent with possibility of small surrounding islands to explore. The [b]Continents[/b] map has two or more continents with small islands two—using embark here is a must! The [b]New World[/b] has the same; two or more continents but all players start on the same continent.

[h3][b]Other balance changes[/b][/h3]
As always we are always optimizing Hexarchy’s gameplay so check out the patch notes for more info and the full rundown of changes.

[h3][b]Conquer the continents tournament![/b][/h3]
Hoist the sails, because we're throwing a tournament to celebrate the launch of the new update! All the details can be found on Discord.

To be the first to hear about new info and community events join our Discord.

[h3]Full patch notes[/h3]

[b]New Unit - Warship[/b]
[list]
[*] Ranged naval unit
[*] 7 strength
[*] Unlocks with Astronomy
[/list]

[b]New Ability - Embark[/b]
[list]
[*] Turn a unit into a boat that can travel over water
[*] Requires hex with Harbor in most cases
[*] Costs 1 Hammer
[*] Units that have embarked once can re-embark without a Harbor
[*] Movement bonuses are only 50% effective on embarked units
[/list]

[b]New Civilization - Vikings[/b]
Passive Bonuses:
[list]
[*] When you Embark a unit, draw a card that grants Charge once per turn
[*] Get luxury resources and extra victory points when pillaging
[/list]

[b]Viking Unit - Ulfhednar[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlocks a tech tier 2
[*] 8 strength
[*] Cost 3 Hammer or 2 Luxury
[*] Can Embark for free from any hex
[*] Card gains 1 strength every 2 turns
[/list]

[b]Viking Ability - Frenzy[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlocks at tech tier 3
[*] Cost 3 Hammer or 3 Luxury
[*] For this turn, give a unit +8 Strength, Charge, and Mobilize
[/list]

[b]Multiple Map Types[/b]
[list]
[*] Pangea - classic one continent
[*] Continents - 2 or more continents with bonus islands
[*] New World - 2 or more continents but all players start on the same one
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Jaguar starting strength increased to 5
[*] Scout gather ability always costs 1 hammer
[*] City maintenance over water without harbor reduced
[*] Harbor no longer grants free resources when built
[*] Vanguard cost reduced to 2 Hammers
[*] Military Engineer cost reduced to 1 Hammer
[/list]

[b]Other noteworthy changes[/b]
[list]
[*] "Fast Events" menu option to significantly increase speed at which events play between turns 
[*] New "No Immediate Charges" game setting to disallow Charge attacks for a unit on the turn it was built
[*] Max zoom level increased slightly

notes.title: Hexarchy 1.0.817 - Introducing Singleplayer save feature
notes.content:
Hi all.

It’s been thrilling to see so many people playing and enjoying Hexarchy since launch. It’s been brilliant seeing a huge number of people connect with the game, and enjoying fast-paced 4X sessions either solo or in online multiplayer.

We’ve read everything you’ve sent us. And whilst the positives have been overwhelming, it’s those of you who have taken time to offer constructive feedback which we’ve really appreciated. The team has been working incredibly hard to respond to everything that’s been suggested – and we’re delighted to unveil our latest update which hopefully addresses some of the most common observations.

By far the biggest request has been to introduce the option to save a game during a single-player session. There were some technical challenges behind the scenes which had originally made this a pretty complicated feature – but we’re really pleased to say that from this update onwards, players will be able to return to a game mid-session. There are some caveats: the game only saves between turns, you can only have one save game activate at any time, and you will be unable to continue a Challenge or Hegemon game if the time to complete has passed. But hopefully this offers players a way to enjoy the single-player game with a little more freedom. One additional note of caution: we can’t guarantee saves will be compatible between versions, so you may need to roll back to complete a game in progress occasionally. We’ll do our best to keep that to a minimum.

As you would expect: online multiplayer is a little different – all players need to be on the same version, and you can’t save mid-session.
We’re working hard to ensure you have a reason to return to the game over and over, and will confirm what’s next for Hexarchy shortly. But until then, please do read the full patch notes below – and happy hexing!

notes.title: Hexarchy Beta 0.621 and Next Playtest
notes.content:
[h3]New Game Mode - Weekly Campaign[/h3]
Progress through a campaign consisting of 3-5 levels that changes each week. Each level will have 1-3 objectives similar to a daily challenge with generally each level being progressively longer. In between levels you can spend the victory points you've earned to buy powerful one-time use Campaign Cards.

Compete for position on the leaderboard like with the Daily Challenge.


[h3]Campaign Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Population Boom[/b] - Add 3 population to a city
[*] [b]Fuel Forage [/b]- Gather 4 firewood from a forest hex in your territory or near it
[*] [b]Mass Conscription[/b] - Draw 3 unit cards from your deck or discard pile that cost half price
[*] [b]Inferno[/b] - Raze an enemy city that you can see
[*] [b]Pioneering Spirit[/b] - Found a city on any available hex you can see
[*] [b]Marketing Sweep[/b] - Get all resources on the market
[*] [b]Pathfinder[/b] - Grant permanent map vision for a large area around a hex
[*] [b]Mass Mobilization[/b] - Mobilize all of your units
[*] [b]Onslaught[/b] - Give all of your units charge for this turn
[*] [b]Assassinate[/b] - Kill an enemy unit
[*] [b]Glorious Project[/b] - Make a Wonder in your hand cost 1 gold
[/list]


[h3]New Wonders[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Statue of Zeus[/b] - All military units start mobilized
[*][b]Parthenon[/b] - Can view the top 3 cards in your deck
[*][b]Djenne Mosque[/b] - +2 Victory Points for each Holy Site you control
[*][b]Hagia Sophia[/b] - Immediately claims all unclaimed territory within 3 hexes
[*][b]Himeji Castle[/b] - Your first card drawn is always a military unit
[*][b]Great Library[/b] - Grants you any technology that has been researched by over a third of the civilizations in the game
[/list]


[h3]New Buildings[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]University [/b]- Grants 3 science per turn
[*] [b]Market [/b]- +5 gold and +3 gold for every citizen working the city hex
[*] [b]Monastery [/b]- Produces culture and significantly reduces cost of stealing nearby hexes
[/list]


[h3]New Abilities[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Annex [/b]- Buy a neighboring hex with gold
[*] [b]Forced March[/b] - Damages unit for increased movement this turn and Charge
[*] [b]Scorched Earth[/b] - Makes a unit immediately pillage an enemy hex after moving onto it. Lasts 2 turns
[*] [b]Volley [/b]- Gives a ranged unit +1 range for 2 turns
[*] [b]Invest [/b]- Spend 6 gold to immediately get 3 hammers and 6 additional hammers next turn. Usable once per turn
[*] [b]Mass Produce[/b] - This card and the next card played go to the top of your deck
[*] [b]Craftsmanship [/b]- Produce 1 culture for every improvement or building within 2 hexes
[/list]


[h3]New Promotions[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Holy Warrior[/b] - Unit automatically captures a hex it's on and produces 2 culture for the nearest city
[*] [b]General[/b] - Adds 33% strength to all units on this hex and neighboring hexes
[/list]


[h3]New Technologies[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Education[/b]
[*] [b]Currency[/b]
[*] [b]Advanced Tactics[/b]
[*] [b]Theology[/b]
[/list]


[h3]New Civics[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Industrialism (Economic)[/b]
[*] [b]Secularism (Religion)[/b]
[*] [b]State Religion (Religion)[/b]
[/list]


[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Wonder points changed to 4 and 6 instead of 5 and 7
[*] Pyramids - Automatically collects special resources from its hex and neighboring hexes
[*] Temple of Diana - Reduces culture required for border growth
[*] Chichen Itza - Removes gold maintenance cost for all cities within 3 hexes
[*] Shield Wall Ability - Moved to Advanced Tactics tech
[*] Courthouse Building - Moved to Theology. Now completely removes gold maintenance cost
[*] Combat Medicine Ability - Replaces Healing Ritual and moved to Secularism civic
[*] Units with the Garrison promotion now exert zone of control
[/list]


[h3]Experimental Bot Emotes (work in progress)[/h3]
[list]
[*] AI players will now comment on events that occur in the game
[*] Currently single-player only
[*] Can be disabled in menu
[/list]


[h3]UI and other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Title screen menus reworked
[*] Tech tree panel reworked
[*] Card manipulation hotkeys - Z draws a card, X destroys the card you're holding, C saves the card you're holding
[*] Can navigate to old challenge leaderboards (currently only works for 1 previous leaderboard)
[*] Capture and pillage events now immediately play for all players in multiplayer
[/list]


[h3]New Music Tracks[/h3]
[list]
[*] 4 new tracks by Landon Walter
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed most of the bugs created by the new content (but surely not all!)
[/list]


The next Hexarchy public Playtest will start on [b]Thursday, June 15[/b]. Thank you, testers - we couldn't do this without you and your feedback!

notes.title: Hexarchy Update 0.269 - UI Revamp, Daily Challenges, and more
notes.content:
[h1]Daily Challenge Mode[/h1]
- Every day at 0:00 GMT, a new single-player map and objective will be created
- All players playing the daily challenge will have the exact same map, civilization, start position, objective, and bot difficulty
- Results and new high score announcements are automatically posted to Discord
- Try multiple times to try to improve your score


[h1]Multiplayer Improvements[/h1]
- Can play single-player while queued for a multiplayer game
- Can queue for a multiplayer game from the menu while already in a single-player game
- Multiplayer game results are announced on Discord if at least 2 players in the game are on Discord


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
- Gold distribution now prioritizes cities before units. This makes it easier to starve enemy armies by cutting supply lines.
- Pillage removes maintenance costs from the pillaging unit for several turns 
- Pillage now gives victory points as well as gold
- Barracks no longer prevents population consumption. Population is consumed from nearest city when building a unit
- Barracks must be built within 3 hexes of a city
- Barracks cost reduced
- Farms now produce 2 wheat instead of 1
- Farm cost increased
- Granary now immediately adds a population to the city and also produces 1 food per turn
- Granary cost increased
- Roads cost more to build on hills and forests
- Cities on hills receive an extra defense bonus
- Catapults can be captured with moves, not just attack advances


[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
- Many UI widgets moved and resized to be less cluttered
- New art assets for most UI widgets
- Can now right click to issue move orders
- Added toggle button to show all trade routes
- Added toggle button to show all maintenance routes
- Resource cards replaced with tokens
- Discard pile cards are now face up
- Discard pile cards can be viewed by mousing over it
- Cards saved for next turn are listed on mouseover
- Card shuffle animation when your discard pile is shuffled into your deck
- Detailed information panel when you mouseover a city's food and luxury bars
- Detailed information panel when you mouseover your hammers and gold
- Detailed information panel when you mouseover a resource in the trade panel
- Added hex "cards" with information about the selected hex including resources and defense bonuses
- Removed summary panel in the top right
- Unit banners have pips indicating the number of units on a hex
- Units have an indicator under them to make it more apparent what team they are on
- Card description improvements
- Unit cards on the selected hex are now clearly split between units that have orders and units that don't
- Cards that are added by tech cards no longer popup when you mouseover the tech card
- Road building path improvements
- Added screen resolution selection to game menu 


[h1]Graphical Improvements[/h1]
- New farm building
- Added cloud shadows
- Added birds
- Added post processing effects 
- Borders are sharper
- Unit shader changes
- Building size changes


[h1]Bot Improvements[/h1]
- Bots build a lot of things they used to not build
- Bots should be more challenging


[h1]Noteworthy Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where catapults would not always attack when they should have
- Fixed issues with unit attack advances
- Fixed a bug where units could attack mountain and water hexes
- Fixed a texture glitch that could occur during combat animations
- Fixed a bug where units occupying enemy cities would only have 1 gold maintenance
- And many more

[b]Big thanks to ATotalParadox and all of our testers on Discord - especially Rpsaxy, Dragonofdark, Moulefrite, Anoc, Beldat, and Frrfrr[/b]
